statements.subject: extension
statements.description: As specified in Section 3.2.6 (Service Parameters), custom protocol bindings MUST document how service parameters are transmitted.
actions: Document how service parameters are transmitted within the custom protocol binding specification

statements.subject: extension
statements.post_cond: binding.transmission_mechanism_documented = true & binding.value_constraints_documented = true & binding.reserved_names_documented = true & binding.fallback_strategy_documented = true
actions: Specify the protocol-specific transmission mechanism for service parameter key-value pairs
Specify any limitations on service parameter values (e.g., character encoding, size limits)
Specify any service parameter names reserved by the binding itself
Specify the fallback strategy when the protocol lacks native header support
